# Design Review

Review requirements.md and architecture.md.

Act as a senior architect.

Check:

- Correctness
- Completeness
- Security
- Scalability
- Reliability
- Maintainability
- Performance
- Failure handling
- Requirement traceability

Generate design-review.md.

Clearly identify:

- Critical risks
- High risks
- Medium risks
- Low risks
- Recommended changes

Do not silently modify architecture.
